scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --prefix server && npm run prisma:seed --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
